next_question: On the same verified-reachable stdlib HTTP substrate, stop measuring how often work repeats and instead measure what is epistemically visible to an executor: define D(s) = the correct next action of a span as a function of the executor's own observable state, and decompose the deopt ratchet's residual into (i) merely-novel spans that close when a no-memory executor is given the goal/intent as a conditioning prefix while inducing no parameters and retaining no compiled memory, (ii) epistemically blocked spans where byte-identical observations require different correct actions and only parameter induction or persistent cross-episode memory can bind them, and (iii) observation-absent spans whose binding key is not present in the conditioning context at all. Measure the three shares as a function of residual-novelty rate on the pre-declared {0.00, 0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 1.00} grid, with a planted-disambiguation positive control (goal-distinct, observation-identical work items whose binding key is carried in the goal), a matched null in which states are rendered unique by construction so that shares (ii) and (iii) must be exactly 0, and this packet's unconditioned B-NO-MEMORY-DETERMINISTIC arm as the reference arm. Falsifier: if share (ii) is 0 within the plan family, the ratchet's residual is irreducibly binding and inherited parameterization has a real economic niche; if the conditioned arm reaches or exceeds this packet's measured compiled-replay coverage (0.6857 of deterministic span occurrences, 0.40 of all span occurrences) at equal or lower amortized cost, then goal conditioning substitutes for inherited parameterization and SPIDER's mechanism-accumulation premise is falsified in setting on identified, executable arms.
why_next: The part of this program that failed is the comparison against inherited execution, and it failed for an instrument reason rather than a scientific one: the incumbent arm could not execute anything, so the frozen rule's discriminating premise was never met and the producer correctly refused to fire the falsifier. Re-running the same three-way comparison on the same substrate, or with the novelty rate swept again, would reproduce the same unidentified leg and add no discriminating information. The highest-information untested object this run exposed is the one the positive control failed on for a structural reason: byte-identical observations that require different correct actions, which a no-memory state-to-action executor provably cannot disambiguate without parameter induction. That is a different level of description from span-repetition frequency - it asks what is epistemically visible to a no-memory executor, not how often work happens to repeat - and it is the exact locus where conditioning and memory are not interchangeable, so it is where an identified comparison against inheritance could finally be built. It is also immediately executable: same stdlib HTTP substrate already verified reachable in this environment, same oracle discipline, no browser, no docker, no LLM key, no unavailable dataset, which matters because the program's dominant MEASUREMENT_INVALID class is caused by pre-registered gates on substrates that do not exist. Frontier exists to search outside the solution basin and must not re-plan a repaired copy of a failed instrument, so this is the materially orthogonal move; the C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE objective deliberately stays with Graph, per this cycle's mandate. This handoff is continuity state, not authorization for a child experiment: a new Global Research Director mandate and preregistration are required, and the two owning-lane deliverables named in dependencies would change how the next packet is designed.

DEOPT_RATCHET_BEATS_COLD_ON_THIS_PLAN_FAMILY (this is the audit's own maximum justified claim, and the one leg of the three-way comparison that is identified): a no-memory compiled executor with a selective deopt-to-agent ratchet is cheaper than always-deopting cold exploration at matched correctness - 38.6 vs 72.0 abstract units per episode, success 1.0 in all three arms, paired bootstrap deopt-minus-cold mean -33.4 with CI95 [-34.0, -32.4] over 50 paired episodes - and it is cheaper at every one of the five pre-declared novelty rates (deopt-minus-cold = -41.0, -36.75, -32.5, -28.25, -24.85 for target_novelty_rate 0.00/0.25/0.50/0.75/1.00). BOUNDED EVIDENCE FOR C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY ITSELF, at the claim ceiling: at FIXED task length (24 span occurrences per episode in every arm and every novelty condition) amortized cost of the compiling executor is strictly monotone increasing in residual-novelty rate (31.0, 35.25, 39.5, 43.75, 47.15 abstract units/episode) while always-deopting cold exploration is novelty-invariant at 72.0. Because length is held constant, the cost variation is attributable to residual novelty and cannot be attributed to task length. This is why C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY was moved to EXPERIMENTAL and not left at HYPOTHESIS, and it is equally why it was not moved further.

COMPILABILITY BOUNDARY, quantified and decomposed: 0.5833 of span occurrences (700 of 1200) are witnessed-deterministic, but only 0.6857 of those (480) are actually served from compiled replay, i.e. 0.40 of all span occurrences. The 220-occurrence loss splits exactly, and was independently recomputed by AUDIT from the raw span records: 100 occurrences where the observable state key recurred but mapped to more than one correct action (observationally identical, goal-distinct), 100 where the observable state key never recurred because it embedded an episode-specific previous request, and 20 that are the first two witnesses of each remaining key under the preregistered 2-witness rule. Operational detail: 10 of 511 observed state keys compiled, compilation completed at episode 2, model calls fell 24/episode in episodes 1-2 to 14/episode from episode 3 onward and stayed flat, 480 compiled replays total.

WITNESS-COUNT STRUCTURE: the histogram is strictly bimodal - 500 span occurrences witnessed in exactly one episode, 700 in all 50, none at any intermediate witness count. A synthetic mixture of 'never repeats' and 'always repeats' spans, with no partial-repetition middle.

THE SHIPPED INCUMBENT KERNEL IS NON-EXECUTABLE UNDER THE PREREGISTERED CONFIGURATION (operational diagnostic about the incumbent arm, confirmed by AUDIT B1 and by direct probe): across 1200 resolve calls on a registry of 24 distilled mechanisms there were 689 EXPLORE, 511 UNKNOWN, 0 EXECUTABLE, 0 mechanisms executed, 0 bind calls, 0 verify calls, 0 freshness checks; PC-EXACT-REPLAY independently returned 0 of 48 EXECUTABLE. The per-span witnessed-determinism fraction of REAL agent work. It is measured only on an experimenter-authored task plan (five preregistered intents, four-work-item episodes, 24 spans, MAIN_NOVELTY_RATE 0.50, fixed in research/frontier/taskplan.py before any arm ran). A captured real trajectory distribution is the only design that turns this into a claim-level number.

How the compilability-gap decomposition generalises: 0.6857 of deterministic occurrences were compilable and the three causes were 100 observationally-identical-but-goal-distinct, 100 never-recurring state keys and 20 witness-buildup. How much real work is of each kind is unknown.

Whether the deopt ratchet's advantage survives a non-ideal model. The oracle was a deterministic perfect-policy function at a fixed unit price, so the measured saving is an UPPER BOUND relative to real model calls and unknown relative to real model pricing and reliability. token_denominated_cost and browser_or_dom_measurements are both null; no policy-model credential exists in this environment.

Whether the inherited arm would be cost-competitive once executable. The registry does hold 24 mechanisms that match intent and preconditions exactly and are blocked by a single scalar gate, but nothing in this run indicates what executing them would cost, because none was executed.

Which minimal repair makes the incumbent arm executable. Two measured candidates exist and this lane is not authorized to choose between them: lower SpiderKernel min_confidence to <= 0.5, or give distill() a real confidence model. Neither is a scientific finding of this experiment and neither may be applied to a frozen comparison without a new mandate.

Whether the DEOPT_TIES and DEOPT_LOSES branches of the frozen rule are reachable at all on this substrate. The incumbent arm's cost is pinned to the null's cost by total non-executability, which no novelty setting can change. The break-even novelty rate for the ratchet was not located either, because the ratchet was cheaper than cold at every swept point.

Whether C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE is structurally unreachable. Consistent with but not established by this run: a paraphrased intent resolved UNKNOWN against a registry holding an exact mechanism, but the experiment was not designed to test semantic resolution and only one paraphrase was probed. This claim is assigned to Graph in this cycle's mandate.

Whether a cluster-corrected interval for the determinism fraction would change any inference. The reported Wilson CI [0.555, 0.611] treats 1200 span occurrences as independent Bernoulli trials, but spans within an episode share a work item and a store state, so the true sampling unit is the episode (n=50) and a cluster-corrected interval would be wider.

Whether the model-quality and cost asymmetry between the two arms matters. The deopt ratchet is given only the substrate world state and its own last request, while the oracle is handed the remaining task plan. This asymmetry is conservative with respect to the treatment arm but means the deopt arm is not solving the same inference problem a real model would.

The unresolved spec/prereg positive-control criterion conflict, by design: spec.json says 'compile all spans on first episode' and 'model_calls_after_compile=0', while prereg.md 6.1 requires >= 2 witnesses and prereg.md 8.1 reads 'model_calls_after_episode_1 = 0'.
